description.subtitle: Liverpool adidas short training pants for the Champions League 2026 2027 - grey
description.tagline: Entrena con la intensidad del Liverpool
description.intro: The Liverpool Short adidas UCL training is designed to accompany you in demanding football sessions with maximum comfort. Its interlock fabric offers a soft and comfortable touch, while the adidas Climacool technology absorbs and disperses sweat to help you maintain a cool and dry feeling when the intensity increases. Its sporty design is completed with the Liverpool shield, bringing the identity of the Reds to a garment prepared for workouts, warm-ups and physical preparation sessions.
key_benefits: Frescura durante el esfuerzo: Climacool ayuda a absorber y dispersar el sudor durante los entrenamientos.
Sporty comfort: The interlock fabric provides a soft touch to face intense sessions.
Custom fit: The waistband with cord allows to adjust the grip according to your preferences.
Freedom of movement: Its short pants design facilitates racing, directional changes and ball exercises.
Identidad Liverpool: El escudo del club completa una prenda pensada para entrenar representando a los Reds.
